name: X01 · Debug me: the paid-orders report

parameters.content:
## 🐞 X01 · This workflow has 3 bugs
It should list the **3 paid orders**, each with 18% tax added and its own label.
1. Click **Execute workflow**.
2. Read the error from **✅ Check**: it names what's still wrong.
3. Fix one bug, run again, repeat until it says *All fixed*.
Don't edit ✅ Check or Orders.
